subject: Confidential eval support request — credits, audit access, and escrow plan
messages:
From: Emma Walker <emma.walker@peregrinehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurements@peregrinehealth.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel@cybersafe.io>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Secured VPC POC — sponsorship request and evidence checklist

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Peregrine is excited to evaluate Redwood for a data-sensitive medtech pilot. A few constraints on our side: the pilot must run in an isolated VPC, logs need to be written to an auditable, read-only repository for our compliance team, and we require a short escrow arrangement for evidence access if anything changes post-pilot.

Request: can Redwood sponsor the infra/usage with promotional credits for a 3–4 week VPC POC? We are aiming for a workflow that ingests PHI-like records (synthetic) and requires SOC 2 attestation for the runtime components. We can supply a scoped security questionnaire and bring our external auditor (Dan) into the loop.

Attachments: peregrine_security_questionnaire.pdf (answers + required controls)

High-level ask:
- Pilot window: 3 weeks (target start 24 Aug)
- Sponsored credits for compute + dedicated capacity (ballpark $15k)
- Audit / escrow access plan and MSA addendum for restricted data handling

Can you confirm what evidence and gating conditions Redwood would need to approve credits and an isolated VPC? Also, any constraints on audit-read-only access to logs (S3/Drive) and timeboxed escrow?

Best,
Emma Walker
Head of Engineering, Peregrine Health
emma.walker@peregrinehealth.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Emma Walker <emma.walker@peregrinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secured VPC POC — sponsorship request and evidence checklist

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We can support an isolated VPC pilot and are open to sponsoring the pilot with promotional credits, subject to a short set of gating items and a signed POC addendum.

Proposal (initial):
- Offer: $15,000 in Redwood credits applied to VPC Dedicated pilot (valid for the pilot only).
- Term: 3–4 week pilot window; start date flexible but we should onboard the week of Aug 24 to hit your timeline.
- Conditions: signed POC addendum + acceptance of a limited escrow clause that provides timeboxed access to audit artifacts (read-only) in the event of contract termination.
- Required evidence before kickoff: SOC 2 (latest Type II) scope summary for the runtime, pen-test summary or third-party security assessment (redacted OK), KMS/encryption at-rest and in-transit architecture diagram, and a proposed log-retention/access model (S3 path + IAM read-only role for your auditor).

Operational asks:
- We'll provision a dedicated VPC with strict egress controls and a read-only S3 bucket for logs.
- We will not put customer data into our internal analytics.

Next steps:
1) If you confirm, I will route a POC addendum draft to your procurement and attach a checklist for security so we can run a parallel evidence review.
2) Laura (cc'd) will coordinate commercial terms and final credit allocation.

I pulled in Aditya to ensure the infra team signs off on the timeline.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Walker <emma.walker@peregrinehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurements@peregrinehealth.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel@cybersafe.io>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secured VPC POC — sponsorship request and evidence checklist

Nikhil — that looks reasonable. A couple clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: we don't yet have a full Type II that covers your exact runtime, so a scoped readiness report + SOC bridge letter would be fine to start; can Redwood accept a bridging attestation and then provide the full report within 30 days?
- Escrow: we need an attestable, timeboxed snapshot of logs and configurations accessible to our auditor (Dan) if the pilot surface area shows unacceptable risk. We are not asking for ongoing full access — just a one-time forensics snapshot if triggered.
- Data handling: we will only use synthetic PHI for the pilot but will need agreement that you'll not index or retain the synthetic records beyond the pilot retention window.

I've attached our procurement template (procurement_terms.docx) — procurement will want the POC addendum to map to the template. If you can send a draft addendum with the gating checklist I can run it through legal quickly.

Thanks — Emma
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Secured VPC POC — sponsorship request and evidence checklist

Team — forwarding Peregrine's request. Key asks: isolated VPC, read-only audit snapshot for external auditor, and a pilot credit sponsorship (~$15k initially). They accept a bridging SOC attestation and need the POC addendum to map to their procurement template.

Questions:
- Security: can we accept a bridge letter + commit to delivering the full SOC 2 report within 30 days post-kickoff? Are we comfortable with a timeboxed escrow snapshot (read-only) if triggered?
- Commercial: able to approve $15k in pilot credits now? Any appetite to extend to $20k conditional on signed PO / success metric?

I think we should: approve $15k conditional on signed POC addendum + evidence checklist; approve a conditional top-up to $20k if they meet milestone (ingest+latency SLA) and sign the PO. Rishi, can you confirm security gating? Laura, can you start a POC addendum draft attached to procurement_terms.docx — I'll share a DocuSign link to streamline.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Secured VPC POC — sponsorship request and evidence checklist

Nikhil / Laura — quick security sign-off with conditions below. We can approve the pilot credits pending the POC addendum and receipt of the bridge attestation. Conditions: 

1) Evidence required pre-kickoff (can be redacted where necessary):
   - SOC 2 Type II report or bridge attestation + letter of intent to provide full report within 30 days of kickoff.
   - Third-party pen-test summary (high-level).
   - Architecture diagram showing KMS/CMK usage (at-rest + in-transit) and VPC peering details.
   - Proposed S3 bucket path and IAM role for auditor (read-only).

2) Escrow / audit snapshot: timeboxed, one-time snapshot accessible only to Peregrine's auditor (Dan) upon a defined trigger (security incident or contractual dispute). Access will be read-only and delivered via pre-signed S3 URL with logging enabled. We should include an indemnity carve-out in the addendum limiting access to audit artifacts only.

3) Commercials: approve up to $20,000 in total pilot credits — disbursed in two tranches: $15k on signed POC addendum + bridge attestation; $5k on milestone (successful ingest + agreed latency SLA). Require Procurement PO or DocuSign acceptance that references the POC addendum.

4) Controls: no offboarding of data to internal analytics, retention window of 30 days post-pilot unless otherwise agreed.

If Laura can get a POC addendum draft into DocuSign this week (link to procurement template attached), we can lock dates and provision the VPC. Copying Aditya for infra scheduling.

—Rishi
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
